Actornamen zijn uitsluitend samengevoegd: Actor names are combined only by normalising case and whitespace. Identical descriptions are not verified actor IDs.
Unieke acts per opgeslagen lezersreferen: Unique acts per recorded reader reference; multiple readings are not counted twice within a category. An act may occur in multiple categories.
Alleen expliciete NUMAC-matches zijn gen: Only explicit NUMAC matches are normalised. Free-text references are not merged using inferred titles.
Niet-herkende organen en beleidsrubrieke: Unidentified authorities and policy categories remain Unknown. Policy categories follow an explicit service heading or proposing ministerial portfolio; they are not a subject classification of each act.
